paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior FP&A Analyst role at Glia. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I'm interested in Glia because it sells AI to banks and credit unions, and this role connects the operating plan across go-to-market and product at a company that is still scaling.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst, building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15% and running variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation. At JPMorgan Asset Management I worked as a consultant on marketing-channel budget allocation. I built models to evaluate $10M in spend, benchmarked past allocations to find 30% in efficiency gains, and prepared executive-level briefs for senior leadership. At Thomson Reuters I supported monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region.

That maps to the operating plan, department budgets and board and executive reporting here. SaaS metrics and a planning platform like Adaptive would be new for me, but I work well in Excel, Salesforce and Tableau and pick up tools quickly. I'd welcome the modeling test and the chance to talk.
